I developed this infographic for the UC Water Academy (2025) and presented it to UC faculty and graduate students. The Cuyama Valley, in northern Santa Barbara County, offers a clear example of how groundwater depletion exposes the limits of current laws like SGMA and reflects governance issues seen in stressed aquifers globally.This project highlights:

-   decades of severe groundwater overdraft

-   exploitation from large agricultural corporations

-   inequities experienced by small farmers and rural households

This work served as a policy case study evaluating the effectiveness and limitations of the Sustainable Groundwater Management Act (SGMA) in regions with groundwater conflicts. I compiled historical groundwater level data, created depth-to-water hydrographs, and emphasized how effective visual communication can make complex groundwater issues accessible to decision makers and the public.
